== Biography ==
Charles was born about 1841.
<ref name="ytw"/>

On 1 Feb 1867 at the 4th Presbyterian Church, Philadelphia, he married Annie Henderson.
<ref>{{Ancestry Record|PresbyterianSociety|1300831482}} Presbyterian Historical Society; Philadelphia, Pennsylvania; U.S., Presbyterian Church Records, 1701-1907; Book Title: Register, 1843-1878; Accession Number: VAULT BX 9211 .P49143 F62 v.3</ref>

They returned to Ireland not long afterwards, living at Killycurragh, near Cookstown.

In 1911 he applied to the Cookstown Pension Committee based on being age 9 in the 1851 census and was told he had a year to wait. He claimed to be supported by a son in America.
<ref name="ytw">[https://www.britishnewspaperarchive.co.uk/viewer/bl/0002006/19110311/182/0009 "A Year to Wait"], ''Mid-Ulster Mail'' - Saturday 11 March 1911</ref>

In the 1911 census he was recorded as a widower married 27 years (?), with 7 children, 3 still alive.

He passed away 19 Aug 1917 age 75 at Killycurragh. Informed by John Glasgow, Killycurragh.
<ref>[https://civilrecords.irishgenealogy.ie/churchrecords/details-civil/ac98693484967 James Glasgow, 1917, Cookstown, 75] at Irish Civil Registration - Deaths</ref>
